proposal.summary: An information disclosure in GitLab EE allowed other Group Owners to view the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination; fixed in 16.2.5 and 16.3.1 so Owners can only write the key, not read it.
proposal.cwe_quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

C.quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Apply the vendor fix (upgrade GitLab EE to 16.2.5 or 16.3.1) and, if there is concern keys were exposed, advise administrators to rotate the Google Cloud Logging keys for affected destinations.

evidence_quotes.quote: affecting all versions from 16.2 prior to 16.2.5, and 16.3 prior to 16.3.1
see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.
Owners can now only write the key, not read it.
